# CAIRN Handbook

> How QURI builds and maintains CAIRN, its monorepo of LLM-assisted research wikis: adding a wiki, the build and link-checking tooling, the review workflow, and a workshop on building research websites with Claude Code.

The wikis: Delegation Risk (https://delegation-risk.quantifieduncertainty.org), Evaluation Engineering (https://evaluation-engineering.quantifieduncertainty.org), and Robust Reasoning Processes (https://reasoning-processes.quantifieduncertainty.org). Source: https://github.com/quantified-uncertainty/cairn.


## Handbook

- [Adding a Wiki](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/adding-a-wiki/): How to add a new Starlight wiki to the CAIRN monorepo, from the starter template to a deployed, CI-checked site.
- [Build & Tooling](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/build-and-tooling/): The CAIRN repository layout, the generated llms.txt files, the built-site link checker, the version footer, and the shared Starlight package.
- [Review Workflow](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/review-workflow/): How CAIRN's audit and revision rounds are run, from read-only audit to integrated, link-checked pull request.

## Workshop

- [Building Research Websites](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/workshop/): A hands-on workshop on using Claude Code to build research mini-textbooks, wikis, and structured knowledge bases
- [Claude Code on the Web](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/claude-code-web-app/): Using Claude Code at claude.ai/code to build a research website with no local setup, previewing changes through Vercel preview deployments.

## Optional

- [Complete text](https://cairn-meta.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every chapter above, concatenated in reading order
